description: This file defines the 'KpiMenuConfigurator' class within the OrangeHRM Performance module. The class implements the 'MenuConfigurator' interface and uses traits to assist with module screen handling. Its main purpose is to configure a menu related to KPI search functionality by overriding certain screen settings.

classes.name: KpiMenuConfigurator
classes.description: Configures the KPI Menu for the Performance module by overriding screen settings relevant to KPI search.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the current screen to 'searchKpi' and returns null, implementing menu configuration for the KPI search functionality.
